versions.changelog:
Expanded to use the full 78-card tarot deck for richer, more authentic readings.

- Now supports the complete Major and Minor Arcana (Wands, Cups, Swords, Pentacles).
- Random card selection ensures variety and ethical interpretation in every reading.
- Updated documentation to reflect the broader card set and clarify deck contents.

- Initial release of Aether Tarot for the ClawHub ecosystem.
- Provides calm, supportive, AI-powered tarot readings using a 3-card Past/Present/Future spread.
- Features natural language conversation and context-aware, privacy-focused responses.
- Designed for users looking for gentle, jargon-free tarot insights and personal reflection.
- Optimized for stable, lightweight performance.
